value.title: Cache - Web APIs | MDN - MDN Web Docs
value.snippet: The Cache interface provides a persistent storage mechanism for Request / Response object pairs that are cached in long lived memory. How long a Cache object lives is browser dependent, but a single origin's scripts can typically rely on the presence of a previously populated Cache object. Note that the Cache interface is exposed to windowed scopes as well as workers. You don't have to use it ...
